params.body:
## What

The newsletter list is kept by the website and managed on its own admin page, `/newsletter-admin`.

## Why

The "Stay in the loop" form on the home page posted to nowhere, and the list lived in a spreadsheet. With the list in the site's own back office there is one place that holds it, next to the finance page, and both afrodidact.org and kubo.global can feed it.

## What is in it

- **Sign-up** (`/api/newsletter-signup`): from the home page form and, across sites, from kubo.global (only those two origins may read the answer). A new person is stored as pending and mailed a link; the click puts them on the list. A hidden field catches robots, and one sender gets five sign-ups per ten minutes.
- **Confirm and unsubscribe pages** (`/newsletter/confirm`, `/newsletter/unsubscribe`), in the subscriber's language. Unsubscribing takes a button press, so a mail program that opens links cannot do it.
- **Admin page** (`/newsletter-admin`, same token as `/finance`): the list with search and filter, add one person, paste many from a spreadsheet (with a check that counts without importing), unsubscribe, put back, remove.
- **Export** (`/api/newsletter-export`): CSV per language, for the general newsletter or a KUBO one, each row with that person's unsubscribe link.
- **Privacy page**: a paragraph on the newsletter in three languages, and the processors list updated.

## Decisions worth knowing

- Subscribers are stored in Sanity under ids that start with `subscriber.`. The dataset is readable without a login, and a document with a dot in its id is the exception.
- The id is derived from the address, so one address is one subscriber.
- Someone who unsubscribed stays known as unsubscribed, so an import cannot bring them back. "Remove" deletes everything, for someone who asks to be forgotten.
- People added by hand or by import are on the list at once, without a confirmation mail.
- The sign-up answers the same whether or not the address was known.
- No Studio type: the admin page is the place to manage the list.

## Checked

- `npm test` (74 pass) and `npm run build`.
- Run locally with made-up people: admin page at desktop and phone width, import check, export, refusal without the token, both public pages with an unknown link.
- Not run: the writes to Sanity and the confirmation mail, which need the server's tokens. To test after deploy: sign up on the home page, click the link in the mail, see the person on `/newsletter-admin`, unsubscribe through the link in the export.

## Not in it

- Sending the newsletter. The export is what a sending tool takes in.
- A link from `/finance` to this page; the page links back to `/finance`.
params.title: Newsletter list in the site's own admin
